"""MIDIVOLT optional model-inference command."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import json
import sys
from .model_adapters import generate_candidate

def main(argv=None):
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="midivolt-model")
    modes = p.add_subparsers(dest="model", required=True)
    for name in ("text2midi", "anticipation"):
        m = modes.add_parser(name)
        for opt in ("python", "checkout", "checkpoint", "out"):
            m.add_argument("--" + opt, required=True)
        m.add_argument("--source")
        m.add_argument("--manifest")
        m.add_argument("--lock", type=int, action="append")
        m.add_argument("--timeout", type=float, default=1200)
        m.add_argument("--seed", type=int)
        if name == "text2midi":
            for opt in ("prompt", "vocab", "t5-dir"):
                m.add_argument("--" + opt, required=True)
            m.add_argument("--temperature", type=float, default=0.9)
            m.add_argument("--max-tokens", type=int, default=2000)
        else:
            m.add_argument("--melody-program", type=int, required=True)
            m.add_argument("--seconds", type=float, required=True)
            m.add_argument("--top-p", type=float, default=0.98)
    a = p.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        result = generate_candidate(
            model=a.model, python_executable=a.python, checkout=a.checkout,
            checkpoint=a.checkpoint, output_path=a.out, source_path=a.source,
            manifest_path=a.manifest, locked_tracks=a.lock,
            timeout=a.timeout, seed=a.seed, prompt=getattr(a, "prompt", None),
            vocab_path=getattr(a, "vocab", None), t5_dir=getattr(a, "t5_dir", None),
            temperature=getattr(a, "temperature", 0.9),
            max_tokens=getattr(a, "max_tokens", 2000),
            melody_program=getattr(a, "melody_program", None),
            seconds=getattr(a, "seconds", None), top_p=getattr(a, "top_p", 0.98),
        )
    except (ValueError, OSError, RuntimeError) as exc:
        print(f"MIDIVOLT model error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    print(json.dumps(result.as_dict(), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
    return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""MIDIVOLT Model Hub CLI: local-first, network/download only with opt-in."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import math
import sys

from .model_hub import (
    CATALOG, ModelHubError, catalog, doctor, download_asset,
    inspect_model, search_models,
)


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="midivolt-hub",
        description="Curated AI MIDI model catalog, compatibility and opt-in downloads.",
    )
    sub = p.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    c = sub.add_parser("catalog", help="Offline curated models; no network")
    c.add_argument("--query")
    s = sub.add_parser("search", help="Offline curated search; --online queries Hugging Face")
    s.add_argument("query")
    s.add_argument("--online", action="store_true")
    s.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=10)
    i = sub.add_parser("inspect", help="Inspect catalog or remote model metadata")
    i.add_argument("model", choices=sorted(CATALOG))
    i.add_argument("--online", action="store_true")
    d = sub.add_parser("doctor", help="Read-only local runtime readiness checks")
    d.add_argument("model", choices=sorted(CATALOG))
    for flag in ("python", "checkout", "checkpoint", "vocab", "t5-dir"):
        d.add_argument("--" + flag)
    f = sub.add_parser("download", help="Fetch ONE verified file from pinned HF commit")
    f.add_argument("model", choices=sorted(CATALOG))
    f.add_argument("--file", required=True)
    f.add_argument("--revision", required=True, help="Full 40-character git commit SHA")
    f.add_argument("--dest", required=True, help="Existing local directory")
    f.add_argument("--accept-license", required=True)
    f.add_argument("--confirm-download", action="store_true")
    f.add_argument("--allow-unsafe-format", action="store_true")
    f.add_argument("--max-mb", type=int, default=2000,
                   help="Size cap in decimal MB (default 2000)")
    return p


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    try:
        if args.command == "catalog":
            result = {"models": catalog(args.query), "network_used": False}
        elif args.command == "search":
            result = search_models(args.query, online=args.online, limit=args.limit)
        elif args.command == "inspect":
            result = inspect_model(args.model, online=args.online)
        elif args.command == "doctor":
            result = doctor(
                args.model, python=args.python, checkout=args.checkout,
                checkpoint=args.checkpoint, vocab=args.vocab, t5_dir=args.t5_dir,
            )
        else:
            if not 1 <= args.max_mb <= 8000:
                raise ValueError("--max-mb must be 1..8000")
            result = download_asset(
                args.model, args.file, args.revision, args.dest,
                confirm=args.confirm_download, accept_license=args.accept_license,
                allow_unsafe_format=args.allow_unsafe_format,
                max_bytes=args.max_mb * 1_000_000,
            )
        print(json.dumps(result, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
    except (ValueError, PermissionError, OSError, ModelHubError) as exc:
        print(f"MIDIVOLT Model Hub error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Invoke published Anticipatory Music Transformer conditioned on local MIDI."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import random
import sys
from pathlib import Path

def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    for name in ("checkout", "checkpoint", "source", "out"):
        p.add_argument("--" + name, required=True)
    p.add_argument("--melody-program", type=int, required=True)
    p.add_argument("--seconds", type=float, required=True)
    p.add_argument("--top-p", type=float, required=True)
    p.add_argument("--seed", type=int)
    a = p.parse_args()
    sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(a.checkout).resolve(strict=True)))
    import pretty_midi
    import torch
    from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM
    from anticipation.convert import midi_to_events, events_to_midi
    from anticipation.tokenize import extract_instruments
    from anticipation.sample import generate

    original = pretty_midi.PrettyMIDI(a.source)
    if not any(inst.program == a.melody_program and inst.notes and not inst.is_drum
               for inst in original.instruments):
        raise ValueError("Selected melody program is absent in source MIDI")
    all_events = midi_to_events(a.source)
    _, melody_controls = extract_instruments(all_events, [a.melody_program])
    if not melody_controls:
        raise ValueError("Selected program produced no model control events")
    if a.seed is not None:
        random.seed(a.seed)
        torch.manual_seed(a.seed)
    model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(
        a.checkpoint, local_files_only=True, trust_remote_code=False)
    device = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else (
        "mps" if torch.backends.mps.is_available() else "cpu")
    model.to(device).eval()
    with torch.no_grad():
        accompaniment = generate(
            model, start_time=0, end_time=a.seconds,
            inputs=[], controls=melody_controls, top_p=a.top_p)
    if not accompaniment:
        raise ValueError("Model generated no accompaniment events")
    midi = events_to_midi(accompaniment)
    midi.save(a.out)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Invoke published Text2midi Transformer with explicitly provisioned local assets."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import pickle
import random
import sys
from pathlib import Path

def main():
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    for name in ("checkout", "checkpoint", "vocab", "t5-dir", "prompt", "out"):
        p.add_argument("--" + name, required=True)
    p.add_argument("--temperature", type=float, required=True)
    p.add_argument("--max-tokens", type=int, required=True)
    p.add_argument("--seed", type=int)
    a = p.parse_args()
    sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(a.checkout).resolve(strict=True)))
    import torch
    from transformers import T5Tokenizer
    from model.transformer_model import Transformer

    if a.seed is not None:
        random.seed(a.seed)
        torch.manual_seed(a.seed)
    device = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else (
        "mps" if torch.backends.mps.is_available() else "cpu")
    # Pickle may execute code: operator MUST verify provenance of this local file.
    with Path(a.vocab).open("rb") as stream:
        remi = pickle.load(stream)
    model = Transformer(len(remi), 768, 8, 2048, 18, 1024,
                        False, 8, device=device)
    state = torch.load(a.checkpoint, map_location=device, weights_only=True)
    model.load_state_dict(state)
    model.to(device).eval()
    tokenizer = T5Tokenizer.from_pretrained(a.t5_dir, local_files_only=True)
    encoded = tokenizer(a.prompt, return_tensors="pt", padding=True, truncation=True)
    with torch.no_grad():
        token_ids = model.generate(
            encoded["input_ids"].to(device),
            encoded["attention_mask"].to(device),
            max_len=a.max_tokens, temperature=a.temperature)
    midi = remi.decode(token_ids[0].tolist())
    midi.dump_midi(a.out)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""MIDIVOLT text instruction -> editable MIDI baseline.

Unlike an LLM music generator, this is a *deterministic* local
arrangement sketcher. Audio-to-MIDI and provider-based AI are separate
capabilities. No third-party trademarks or weights are used.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys

from .io import read_midi, write_midi
from .prompt_music import parse_prompt, generate_sketch, report


def parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="midivolt-prompt", description=__doc__)
    p.add_argument("--prompt", required=True,
                   help="e.g. '8 bars of sparse melody in D minor at 110 bpm'")
    p.add_argument("--out", required=True, help="New Standard MIDI file path")
    p.add_argument("--input", help="Existing Standard MIDI to extend non-destructively")
    p.add_argument("--bars", type=int, help="Override number of generated bars (1..32)")
    p.add_argument("--bpm", type=float, help="Override tempo, or match source MIDI BPM")
    p.add_argument("--key", help="Pitch class, e.g. D, F#, Bb")
    p.add_argument("--mode", choices=["major", "minor"])
    p.add_argument("--parts", nargs="+", choices=["chords", "melody", "bass", "drums"],
                   help="Which separate MIDI parts to generate")
    p.add_argument("--seed", type=int, help="Stable 32-bit seed for variations")
    p.add_argument("--overwrite", action="store_true")
    return p


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    args = parser().parse_args(argv)
    try:
        original = read_midi(args.input) if args.input else None
        explicit = args.bpm
        if original is not None:
            _, tempo = original.get_tempo_changes()
            if len(tempo) != 1:
                raise ValueError("Cannot extend varying source tempo")
            if explicit is None:
                # Source tempo must be the timing source, never prompt text.
                explicit = float(tempo[0])
        spec = parse_prompt(
            args.prompt, key=args.key, mode=args.mode,
            bars=args.bars, bpm=explicit,
            parts=tuple(args.parts) if args.parts else None,
            seed=args.seed,
        )
        result = generate_sketch(spec, source=original)
        write_midi(result, args.out, overwrite=args.overwrite)
        print(json.dumps(
            {**report(spec, result, extended=original is not None),
             "output": args.out}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2,
        ))
        return 0
    except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError) as exc:
        print(f"MIDIVOLT prompt error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
